verses.he: ט֤וֹב פַּ֣ת חֲ֭רֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה־בָ֑הּ מִ֝בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי־רִֽיב׃
verses.en: Better is a dry morsel and quietness therewith, Than a house full of feasting with strife.

verses.he: עֶֽבֶד־מַשְׂכִּ֗יל יִ֭מְשֹׁל בְּבֵ֣ן מֵבִ֑ישׁ וּבְת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.en: A servant that dealeth wisely shall have rule over a son that dealeth shamefully, And shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

verses.he: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וּבֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; But the LORD trieth the hearts. .

verses.he: מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־שְׂפַת־אָ֑וֶן שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִין עַל־לְשׁ֥וֹן הַוֹּֽת׃
verses.en: A evil-doer giveth heed to wicked lips; And a liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.

verses.he: לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.en: Whoso mocketh the poor blasphemeth his Maker; And he that is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

verses.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְתִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: Children’s children are the crown of old men; And the glory of children are their fathers.

verses.he: לֹא־נָאוָ֣ה לְנָבָ֣ל שְׂפַת־יֶ֑תֶר אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לְנָדִ֥יב שְׂפַת־שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.en: Overbearing speech becometh not a churl; Much less do lying lips a prince.

verses.he: אֶֽבֶן־חֵ֣ן הַ֭שֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑יו אֶֽל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it; Whithersoever he turneth, he prospereth.

verses.he: מְֽכַסֶּה־פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְשֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; But he that harpeth on a matter estrangeth a familiar friend.

verses.he: תֵּ֣חַת גְּעָרָ֣ה בְמֵבִ֑ין מֵהַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל מֵאָֽה׃
verses.en: A rebuke entereth deeper into a man of understanding Than a hundred stripes into a fool.

verses.he: אַךְ־מְרִ֥י יְבַקֶּשׁ־רָ֑ע וּמַלְאָ֥ךְ אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י יְשֻׁלַּח־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A rebellious man seeketh only evil; Therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

verses.he: פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל בְּאִ֑ישׁ וְאַל־כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, Rather than a fool in his folly.

verses.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה לֹא־תמיש [תָמ֥וּשׁ] רָ֝עָ֗ה מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, Evil shall not depart from his house.

verses.he: פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע הָרִ֥יב נְטֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water; Therefore leave off contention, before the quarrel break out.

verses.he: מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּמַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the righteous, Even they both are an abomination to the LORD.

verses.he: לָמָּה־זֶּ֣ה מְחִ֣יר בְּיַד־כְּסִ֑יל לִקְנ֖וֹת חָכְמָ֣ה וְלֶב־אָֽיִן׃
verses.en: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool To buy wisdom, seeing he hath no understanding?

verses.he: בְּכָל־עֵ֭ת אֹהֵ֣ב הָרֵ֑עַ וְאָ֥ח לְ֝צָרָ֗ה יִוָּלֵֽד׃
verses.en: A friend loveth at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.

verses.he: אָדָ֣ם חֲסַר־לֵ֭ב תּוֹקֵ֣עַ כָּ֑ף עֹרֵ֥ב עֲ֝רֻבָּ֗ה לִפְנֵ֥י רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: A man void of understanding is he that striketh hands, And becometh surety in the presence of his neighbour.

verses.he: אֹ֣הֵֽב פֶּ֭שַׁע אֹהֵ֣ב מַצָּ֑ה מַגְבִּ֥יהַּ פִּ֝תְח֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־שָֽׁבֶר׃
verses.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife; He that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

verses.he: עִקֶּשׁ־לֵ֭ב לֹ֣א יִמְצָא־ט֑וֹב וְנֶהְפָּ֥ךְ בִּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
verses.en: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good; And he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into evil.

verses.he: יֹלֵ֣ד כְּ֭סִיל לְת֣וּגָה ל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח אֲבִ֣י נָבָֽל׃
verses.en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow; And the father of a churl hath no joy.

verses.he: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב גֵּהָ֑ה וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה תְּיַבֶּשׁ־גָּֽרֶם׃
verses.en: A merry heart is a good medicine; But a broken spirit drieth the bones.

verses.he: שֹׁ֣חַד מֵ֭חֵיק רָשָׁ֣ע יִקָּ֑ח לְ֝הַטּ֗וֹת אָרְח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom, To pervert the ways of justice.

verses.he: אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י מֵבִ֣ין חָכְמָ֑ה וְעֵינֵ֥י כְ֝סִ֗יל בִּקְצֵה־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; But the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

verses.he: כַּ֣עַס לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וּ֝מֶ֗מֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A foolish son is vexation to his father, And bitterness to her that bore him.

verses.he: גַּ֤ם עֲנ֣וֹשׁ לַצַּדִּ֣יק לֹא־ט֑וֹב לְהַכּ֖וֹת נְדִיבִ֣ים עַל־יֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.en: To punish also the righteous is not good, Nor to strike the noble for their uprightness.

verses.he: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ אֲ֭מָרָיו יוֹדֵ֣עַ דָּ֑עַת וקר [יְקַר]־ר֝֗וּחַ אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.en: He that spareth his words hath knowledge; And he that husbandeth his spirit is a man of discernment.

verses.he: גַּ֤ם אֱוִ֣יל מַ֭חֲרִישׁ חָכָ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב אֹטֵ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֣יו נָבֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise; And he that shutteth his lips is esteemed as a man of understanding.
